import datetime, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, re, statistics, subprocess, time
ROOT=pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/ferroni-perf-unicode-classes')
OUT=pathlib.Path('/tmp/ferroni-unicode-refinement-diagnostic'); OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
ENV=dict(os.environ, CRITERION_HOME=str(OUT/'criterion'))
BINS={
 'baseline':pathlib.Path('/tmp/ferroni-unicode-expanded-baseline.bench'),
 'partition':pathlib.Path('/tmp/ferroni-unicode-expanded-candidate.bench'),
 'paired_loop':pathlib.Path('/tmp/ferroni-unicode-paired-loop.bench'),
 'interval_search':pathlib.Path('/tmp/ferroni-unicode-interval-search.bench')}
def utc(): return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
def capture(cmd): return subprocess.check_output(cmd,cwd=ROOT,text=True,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).strip()
def sha(path): return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
data={'format_version':1,'question':'Can paired indexing or early interval membership reduce PR 177 regressions?',
 'purpose':'Diagnostic selection only; any selected variant requires broader confirmation.',
 'start_utc':utc(),'source_commit':'731a68d1d57a816214e271ca67c5acfe57c2737d',
 'variants':{
 'baseline':{'commit':'c6a47b9c49c62a7a4115b8da3b5fa1dd277d8ff2','description':'Main after PR 178 with expanded benchmark fixtures'},
 'partition':{'commit':'5450952d821ccd007e465a4a86c665995e715082','description':'Original PR 177 partition_point implementation; runtime identical to 731a68d'},
 'paired_loop':{'commit':'731a68d1d57a816214e271ca67c5acfe57c2737d','patch':pathlib.Path('/tmp/ferroni-unicode-paired-loop.patch').read_text()},
 'interval_search':{'commit':'731a68d1d57a816214e271ca67c5acfe57c2737d','patch':pathlib.Path('/tmp/ferroni-unicode-interval-search.patch').read_text()}},
 'binary_sha256':{n:sha(p) for n,p in BINS.items()},'rustc':capture(['rustc','-vV']),
 'os':capture(['sw_vers']),'hardware':capture(['sysctl','machdep.cpu.brand_string','hw.memsize','hw.ncpu']),
 'build_command':'FERRONI_ONIGURUMA_DIR=<pinned C checkout> cargo bench --locked --features ffi --bench battle_bench --no-run',
 'upstream_source_commit':pathlib.Path('/tmp/ferroni-match-cache/.cache/upstream/oniguruma-orig/.ferroni-upstream-commit').read_text().strip(),
 'sampling':{'samples':30,'warmup_ms':500,'measurement_seconds':4,'features':['ffi'],'match_cache':False,'lto':'thin'},
 'order_policy':'Rotate four variants by case index; then reverse order. All runs retained.',
 'coordination':'Exclusive advisory CPU gate held throughout. Desktop background activity uncontrolled.',
 'environment_overrides':{k:os.environ.get(k) for k in ['RUSTFLAGS','CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS','CARGO_PROFILE_BENCH_OPT_LEVEL','CARGO_PROFILE_BENCH_LTO','CARGO_BUILD_TARGET','CFLAGS']},
 'runner_source':pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text(),'validation':[],'workloads':[],'measurements':[],'summaries':[]}
def save(): (OUT/'artifact.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
for name,binary in BINS.items():
 result=subprocess.run([str(binary),'--test'],cwd=OUT,env=ENV,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=60)
 (OUT/(name+'-smoke.log')).write_text(result.stdout)
 data['validation'].append({'variant':name,'exit':result.returncode,'successful_cases':result.stdout.count('\nSuccess')})
 if name=='baseline': data['workloads']=[json.loads(l[9:]) for l in result.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('WORKLOAD ')]
 save(); assert result.returncode==0,result.stdout[-3000:]
cases=['general_regex/rust/unicode_words']+['unicode_classes/rust/'+s+'_long' for s in ['letters_latin','letters_no_match','greek','combining_marks','negated_letters']]
data['selected_cases']=cases; save()
for index,case in enumerate(cases):
 variants=list(BINS); forward=variants[index%4:]+variants[:index%4]; order=forward+forward[::-1]
 counts={v:0 for v in variants}; rows=[]
 for variant in order:
  counts[variant]+=1; label=f'diagnostic-{variant}-{counts[variant]}'
  command=[str(BINS[variant]),'^'+re.escape(case)+'$','--bench','--noplot','--save-baseline',label]
  info={'case':case,'variant':variant,'label':label,'command':command,'start_utc':utc(),'load_average':os.getloadavg()}; start=time.monotonic()
  result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=OUT,env=ENV,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=60)
  info.update(exit=result.returncode,elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start)
  (OUT/f'{index:02d}-{label}.log').write_text(result.stdout)
  if result.returncode!=0: data['measurements'].append(info); save(); raise RuntimeError(result.stdout[-3000:])
  path=OUT/'criterion'/case/label
  for key,file in [('estimates','estimates.json'),('samples','sample.json'),('benchmark','benchmark.json')]: info[key]=json.loads((path/file).read_text())
  assert len(info['samples']['times'])==30
  data['measurements'].append(info); rows.append(info); save()
 means={v:[r['estimates']['mean']['point_estimate'] for r in rows if r['variant']==v] for v in variants}
 averages={v:statistics.mean(m) for v,m in means.items()}
 summary={'case':case,'run_means_ns':means,'mean_ns':averages,'time_change_percent':{v:(x/averages['baseline']-1)*100 for v,x in averages.items()}}
 data['summaries'].append(summary); save(); print(json.dumps(summary),flush=True)
data['end_utc']=utc(); save(); print('COMPLETE '+str(OUT/'artifact.json'),flush=True)
